title: kyoto ferries
content:
I understand the task now. Let me clarify: Since Kyoto is an **inland city** without access to the sea, there are no traditional ferry (渡輪) services like in Kobe or Okinawa. That's exactly why we need to create a **creative pivot** - focusing on what ACTUALLY exists in Kyoto: **traditional wooden river boats (川舟)** and **river cruise experiences**.

This approach is similar to how we handled Sendai's theater/culture - adapting the original concept to match local reality.
